photos.description: Looking east across 40th Street at the Church of Saints Cyril & Methodius and St. Raphael is a Roman Catholic parish church in the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of New York, located at 502 West 41st Street, Manhattan, New York City. It was established in 1974 from the parish merger of St. Raphael's Roman Catholic Church and SS. Cyril & Methodius and is staffed by the Franciscan Friars.
